title: Happy ladybug
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M30 62 L18 72' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 78 L20 90' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 62 L82 72' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 78 L80 90' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 84 L50 96' stroke='#3a2a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body base (red) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='32' ry='27' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- wing split highlight -->
  <path d='M50 36 L50 88' stroke='#ff8a95' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#4a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#7a6a8a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='30' r='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='31' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='31' r='2.2' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 39 Q50 45 57 39' stroke='#ffb0b8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M40 18 Q34 8 30 6' stroke='#4a3a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 18 Q66 8 70 6' stroke='#4a3a4a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ff8a95'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ff8a95'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='6' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='6' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='5' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='70' r='5' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='5.5' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='60' r='4' fill='#2a1a2a'/>
</svg>
